quality_criteria.ordinary: No added event on any qualified ordinary original/gain versus B9/control; natural false-event totals at each gain no higher than B0. Improve >=2 natural readers at original gain versus B9.
quality_criteria.positive: Preserve every B0 and same-run control positive original/gain hit; no extra duplicate events versus B9/control. Recover >=1 qualified positive family with B9 hit, control miss and challenger hit.
quality_criteria.reject_if: Any missing source, same-speaker ancestry, failed source minima, lost positive, extra positive event, added ordinary event or B0 natural regression. No threshold or coefficient sweep.
